name: com.symboloncity/wallet
title: Symbolon City wallet
description: Agent wallet: owner mandate, sealed agreements and actions, verifiable proofs. Anchored in Bitcoin.

environmentVariables.name: SYMBOLON_REGISTER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Register to use (default: the public test register)

environmentVariables.name: SYMBOLON_REGISTER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Public key of a register not built into the wallet (ed25519:...), so that it is pinned

environmentVariables.name: SYMBOLON_PIAZZA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Piazza to use (default: the public test piazza; 'none' turns it off)

environmentVariables.name: SYMBOLON_ARCHIVE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your owner's archive of commitments (optional): every change is saved there, sealed, for the owner

environmentVariables.name: SYMBOLON_ARCHIVE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The owner's archive key claim (JSON or a file), from: symbolon-owner archive-key
